notes: Sheet has three drawing panels separated by heavy black lines (the key map shows two 647 areas; the southern one is split in two on the sheet). NORTH (part north, upright, top of sheet down to the heavy line at y about 3550 on the left / running NE to the top right): Winton Road (60 ft, cemetery on its west side, x about 281) and the block to Station Av (40 ft, x about 3240), Euclid Av (40 ft) from Station east past Maple (T from the north) to a bend NE at the right edge, Spring Av (40 ft) from Winton to Station, and the C.H.&D. railroad. SPRING-GROVE-EAST (part spring-grove-east, middle band between the two heavy lines): Spring Grove Av (100 ft) from the left edge (x 85) past Platt (unnamed 25 ft way, T from the NNE) and Clifton Av (40 ft, T from the south, x 810) and then NE along lots 250-266 to Donnell Street (50 ft, printed DONNELL here, DONNELL ST. on 649/656) at the right edge; B. & O. railroad below. The Spring Grove / Donnell crossing centre falls just off the right edge of the paper (Donnell's west face reaches Spring Grove's south face at x 6405, y 2290; the crossing centre is about x 6700, y 1840), so it is not picked. SPRING-GROVE-WEST (part spring-grove-west, bottom band, drawn rotated about 24 deg anticlockwise so Spring Grove runs up to the right): Spring Grove Av from the left edge (x 130, Winton Road is not drawn) along lots 150-166 to Clifton Av at the right, with the stub of Station Av on its north side; Mill Creek and the B. & O. bridge at the bottom. The two Clifton / Spring Grove picks are the same real junction drawn in both southern panels (the 647 labels next to Clifton in each panel point to the other). Spring Grove's north face in the spring-grove-west panel runs just under the heavy panel line. Railroads, Mill Creek, shavings pipes and the elevated conveyor ignored.
